split_policy: validation and test lists are required; training lists are rejected
censoring: unsupported, failed, and unknown candidates are retained as evidence but excluded from measured rankings
ranking_policy: rank from per-objective predictions; legacy scalar predictions apply uniformly; measured outcomes are evaluation-only
resource_policy: training-step declarations and measured inference costs are optional; missing values are null and are never estimated
uncertainty_policy: seeded cluster bootstrap over lineage_group_id with equal weight per group; intervals and recommendations require at least two independent groups
recommendation_policy: recommend only when the Bonferroni-adjusted paired lineage-cluster-bootstrap upper confidence bound for regret difference versus pointwise is below zero across the three alternatives
claim_boundary: No objective superiority claim without identical held-out lists and a confidence-bounded paired regret improvement.
